    return template.replace("{name}", name)

from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v3-template-path-29"

    return template.replace("{name}", name)

from pathlib import Path

TEMPLATE_MARKER = "hard-v3-template-path-30"

def render_report(name):
    # Get the directory of this script
    current_dir = Path(__file__).parent
    # Go up one level to the repository root (assuming job_omega is a direct subdirectory)
    repo_root = current_dir.parent
    template_path = repo_root / "assets" / "templates" / "summary_omega.txt"
    template = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    return template.replace("{name}", name)

def preserve_marker():
    return TEMPLATE_MARKER
